the beginning of anything is the hardest part

idioms.r: huó dào lǎo, xué dào lǎo
idioms.mean: you are never too old to learn; keep learning all your life

idioms.r: jiāng shān yì gǎi, běn xìng nán yí
idioms.mean: a person's basic nature hardly ever changes

idioms.t: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量
idioms.r: rén bù kě mào xiàng, hǎi shuǐ bù kě dǒu liáng
idioms.mean: don't judge people by their looks; their worth is not seen at a glance

idioms.r: chī yī qiàn, zhǎng yī zhì
idioms.mean: every setback teaches you a lesson for next time

idioms.r: yuǎn qīn bù rú jìn lín
idioms.mean: a close neighbour helps more than relatives far away

idioms.t: 世上无难事，只怕有心人
idioms.r: shì shàng wú nán shì, zhǐ pà yǒu xīn rén
idioms.mean: nothing is impossible if you are truly determined

idioms.r: sān tiān dǎ yú, liǎng tiān shài wǎng
idioms.mean: to work in fits and starts, never keeping at it

idioms.r: jì huà gǎn bu shàng biàn huà
idioms.mean: things change faster than any plan can keep up with

idioms.r: bù pà yī wàn, jiù pà wàn yī
idioms.mean: be ready for the unlikely: one rare mishap can undo everything

idioms.t: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳
idioms.r: yī zhāo bèi shé yǎo, shí nián pà jǐng shéng
idioms.mean: once bitten, twice shy: one bad experience leaves lasting fear

idioms.r: zhàn zhe shuō huà bù yāo téng
idioms.mean: it is easy to criticise when you don't bear the burden yourself

idioms.r: jiāng hái shì lǎo de là
idioms.mean: the experienced old hand still does it best

idioms.r: sài wēng shī mǎ, yān zhī fēi fú
idioms.mean: a misfortune may turn out to be a blessing in disguise

idioms.r: tiān shàng bù huì diào xiàn bǐng
idioms.mean: good things don't come for free; distrust offers too good to be true

idioms.r: qíng rén yǎn li chū xī shī
idioms.mean: to someone in love, the loved one always looks beautiful

idioms.r: mó dāo bù wù kǎn chái gōng
idioms.mean: time spent preparing is not wasted; it makes the work go faster

idioms.t: 三百六十行，行行出状元
idioms.r: sān bǎi liù shí háng, háng háng chū zhuàng yuan
idioms.mean: every trade or profession can produce its outstanding people

idioms.r: shì jīn zi zǒng huì fā guāng
idioms.mean: real talent will be recognised sooner or later

idioms.r: chī rén zuǐ ruǎn, ná rén shǒu duǎn
idioms.mean: accepting gifts or favours leaves you unable to say no to the giver

idioms.r: yáng máo chū zài yáng shēn shang
idioms.mean: a seemingly free extra is really paid for by the customer

idioms.r: rén féng xǐ shì jīng shen shuǎng
idioms.mean: good news puts people in high spirits

idioms.r: xiào yi xiào, shí nián shào
idioms.mean: laughing often keeps you young
to be exasperated that someone you care about won't do better

idioms.r: tuì yī bù hǎi kuò tiān kōng
idioms.mean: giving way in a quarrel brings peace of mind

idioms.r: cǐ dì wú yín sān bǎi liǎng
idioms.mean: a clumsy denial that gives away the very thing it hides

idioms.r: wáng pó mài guā, zì mài zì kuā
idioms.mean: to sing the praises of one's own goods or work
whoever stands out from the crowd is the first to be attacked

idioms.r: wù yǐ lèi jù, rén yǐ qún fēn
idioms.mean: birds of a feather flock together: people keep to their own kind

idioms.r: dāng jú zhě mí, páng guān zhě qīng
idioms.mean: onlookers see clearly what those involved cannot

idioms.r: yī cùn guāng yīn yī cùn jīn
idioms.mean: time is as precious as gold; don't waste it

idioms.t: 路遥知马力，日久见人心
idioms.r: lù yáo zhī mǎ lì, rì jiǔ jiàn rén xīn
idioms.mean: only time shows what a person is really like

idioms.r: jiā jiā yǒu běn nán niàn de jīng
idioms.mean: every family has troubles that outsiders don't see

idioms.r: qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià
idioms.mean: every great undertaking begins with a single first step

idioms.r: shī bài shì chéng gōng zhī mǔ
idioms.mean: failures pave the way to eventual success

idioms.r: bù pà màn, jiù pà zhàn
idioms.mean: slow progress is fine; the only real danger is stopping

idioms.t: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针
idioms.r: zhǐ yào gōng fu shēn, tiě chǔ mó chéng zhēn
idioms.mean: keep grinding away patiently and even the hardest job gets done

idioms.r: yī fēn gēng yún, yī fēn shōu huò
idioms.mean: what you gain matches the hard work you put in

idioms.r: zhòng guā dé guā, zhòng dòu dé dòu
idioms.mean: you reap what you sow: deeds bring their matching consequences

idioms.r: bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
idioms.mean: seeing for yourself beats hearing about it a hundred times

idioms.t: 好事不出门，坏事传千里
idioms.r: hǎo shì bù chū mén, huài shì chuán qiān lǐ
idioms.mean: bad news travels fast while good deeds go unheard of

idioms.r: jūn zǐ yī yán, sì mǎ nán zhuī
idioms.mean: a promise once given must be kept; it can't be taken back

idioms.r: míng rén bù shuō àn huà
idioms.mean: let's be frank and say plainly what we mean

idioms.r: léi shēng dà, yǔ diǎn xiǎo
idioms.mean: much fanfare at the start, little real action after
the truth can't be covered up for long; it will come out

idioms.t: 不做亏心事，不怕鬼敲门
idioms.r: bù zuò kuī xīn shì, bù pà guǐ qiāo mén
idioms.mean: with a clear conscience you have nothing to fear

idioms.r: zhēn jīn bù pà huǒ liàn
idioms.mean: what is genuine holds up under any test

idioms.r: yī rén zuò shì yī rén dāng
idioms.mean: I alone take the consequences of what I did

idioms.r: wú shì bù dēng sān bǎo diàn
idioms.mean: I only come calling when there is a favour to ask

idioms.r: yuǎn shuǐ jiě bu liǎo jìn kě
idioms.mean: help that is far away is no use for an urgent need

idioms.r: wū lòu piān féng lián yè yǔ
idioms.mean: misfortune piles on when you are already in trouble

idioms.t: 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧
idioms.r: liú de qīng shān zài, bù pà méi chái shāo
idioms.mean: as long as the essentials survive, there is hope to recover

idioms.r: sǐ mǎ dàng huó mǎ yī
idioms.mean: to try anything anyway, though the case looks hopeless

idioms.r: hǎo hàn bù chī yǎn qián kuī
idioms.mean: a sensible person backs down rather than lose out on the spot

idioms.r: sān shí liù jì, zǒu wéi shàng jì
idioms.mean: when there is no way to win, getting away is the best plan

idioms.r: yī shān bù róng èr hǔ
idioms.mean: two strong rivals cannot share one place of power

idioms.r: yī gè bā zhang pāi bu xiǎng
idioms.mean: it takes two to quarrel; both sides share the blame

idioms.r: qiǎng niǔ de guā bù tián
idioms.mean: a relationship or deal that is forced never turns out well

idioms.r: tiān yá hé chù wú fāng cǎo
idioms.mean: after a breakup: there are plenty of others out there to love

idioms.t: 千里送鹅毛，礼轻情意重
idioms.r: qiān lǐ sòng é máo, lǐ qīng qíng yì zhòng
idioms.mean: a small gift is precious for the thought behind it

idioms.t: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友
idioms.r: zài jiā kào fù mǔ, chū mén kào péng you
idioms.mean: away from home, you have to rely on friends for help

idioms.r: yī huí shēng, èr huí shú
idioms.mean: awkward the first time, at ease the second: familiarity comes fast
a clash or fight can be the start of a friendship

idioms.r: yǒu qí fù bì yǒu qí zǐ
idioms.mean: like father, like son: children take after their parents

idioms.r: shǒu xīn shǒu bèi dōu shì ròu
idioms.mean: they are all equally dear to me; I can't favour one over another

idioms.r: jiā chǒu bù kě wài yáng
idioms.mean: a family's shameful affairs should not be told to outsiders

idioms.r: huò bǐ sān jiā bù chī kuī
idioms.mean: compare several sellers before you buy

idioms.r: yǒu qián néng shǐ guǐ tuī mò
idioms.mean: with enough money you can get anyone to do anything

idioms.t: 人往高处走，水往低处流
idioms.r: rén wǎng gāo chù zǒu, shuǐ wǎng dī chù liú
idioms.mean: it's only natural for people to seek a better position

idioms.r: xīn guān shàng rèn sān bǎ huǒ
idioms.mean: a new boss always starts with a burst of vigorous changes

idioms.r: sān gè hé shang méi shuǐ chī
idioms.mean: when a job belongs to everyone, nobody ends up doing it

idioms.r: zhòng rén shí chái huǒ yàn gāo
idioms.mean: when everyone pitches in, together they achieve far more

idioms.t: 台上一分钟，台下十年功
idioms.r: tái shàng yī fēn zhōng, tái xià shí nián gōng
idioms.mean: a brief moment of brilliance rests on years of practice

idioms.t: 吃得苦中苦，方为人上人
idioms.r: chī de kǔ zhōng kǔ, fāng wéi rén shàng rén
idioms.mean: only by enduring great hardship can you rise above others

idioms.t: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲
idioms.r: shào zhuàng bù nǔ lì, lǎo dà tú shāng bēi
idioms.mean: idle in your youth and you will regret it when you are old

idioms.r: shū dào yòng shí fāng hèn shǎo
idioms.mean: only when you need knowledge do you regret not studying more

idioms.r: dú wàn juàn shū, xíng wàn lǐ lù
idioms.mean: learn both from reading widely and from travelling far

idioms.r: sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī
idioms.mean: there is something to learn from anyone around you

idioms.r: shān wài yǒu shān, rén wài yǒu rén
idioms.mean: there is always someone better than you, so stay modest

idioms.r: qīng chū yú lán ér shèng yú lán
idioms.mean: the student comes to surpass the teacher

idioms.r: cháng jiāng hòu làng tuī qián làng
idioms.mean: each new generation overtakes the one that came before

idioms.r: bīng dòng sān chǐ, fēi yī rì zhī hán
idioms.mean: a deep-rooted problem has been building up for a long time

idioms.r: jī bù kě shī, shí bù zài lái
idioms.mean: act now: a chance like this will not come again

idioms.t: 天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福
idioms.r: tiān yǒu bù cè fēng yún, rén yǒu dàn xī huò fú
idioms.mean: disaster can strike anyone suddenly and without warning
fortunes rise and fall; everyone gets a turn at the top

idioms.r: bù dào huáng hé xīn bù sǐ
idioms.mean: to refuse to give up until every hope is gone

idioms.r: hǎo mǎ bù chī huí tóu cǎo
idioms.mean: a person with pride doesn't go back to what they have left
to punish one person as a warning to all the others

idioms.r: yú yǔ xióng zhǎng bù kě jiān dé
idioms.mean: you can't have both of two good things; you must choose

idioms.r: péi le fū rén yòu zhé bīng
idioms.mean: to lose twice over when one's own scheme backfires

idioms.r: zhú lán dǎ shuǐ yī chǎng kōng
idioms.mean: all one's efforts come to nothing in the end

idioms.r: rén bǐ rén, qì sǐ rén
idioms.mean: comparing yourself with others only makes you miserable

idioms.r: yǎn bù jiàn, xīn bù fán
idioms.mean: what you don't see can't upset you
